_comment: NPC catalog — non-player characters the game references by id. Each record carries a name, sprite (rendered when the NPC appears on a map or in dialog), `personal_history` (the long backstory text designers and writers can lean on for voice / motivation), and a `dialogs` array. Each dialog is a { id, title, text } record so quests / scripts can reference a specific dialog by stable id (e.g. npc.dialogs.where('id', 'introduction')). The `id` on a dialog is unique within the NPC, not globally; the `title` is a short human-readable label for the editor list view. See docs/data_dictionary/npc.md.

npcs.name: Olga
npcs.personal_history: Olga bought her shop after her adventuring brother left her everything.

dialogs.title: Greeting
dialogs.text: Hello fellow traveler, may I interest you in my wares?

npcs.name: Garath
npcs.personal_history: Garath comes from a noble family, but he is a bit of a scoundrel.
